submitted_sql: SELECT t.track_id, SUM(il.quantity) AS purchased_quantity FROM public.invoice_line il JOIN public.invoice i ON il.invoice_id = i.invoice_id JOIN public.track t ON il.track_id = t.track_id WHERE i.invoice_date >= DATE '2021-01-01' AND i.invoice_date < DATE '2023-01-01' GROUP BY t.track_id ORDER BY purchased_quantity DESC, t.track_id ASC LIMIT 10;
validated_sql: SELECT t.track_id, SUM(il.quantity) AS purchased_quantity FROM public.invoice_line AS il JOIN public.invoice AS i ON il.invoice_id = i.invoice_id JOIN public.track AS t ON il.track_id = t.track_id WHERE i.invoice_date >= CAST('2021-01-01' AS DATE) AND i.invoice_date < CAST('2023-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY t.track_id ORDER BY purchased_quantity DESC, t.track_id ASC LIMIT 10
